import { test } from '@e2e-dev/web';
import { expect } from 'e2e';

const first = () => { globalThis.initOrder = [...(globalThis.initOrder ?? []), 'first']; };
const second = () => {
  globalThis.initOrder = [...(globalThis.initOrder ?? []), 'second'];
  if (window.opener && location.href === 'about:blank') window.opener.postMessage({ kind: 'init-blank', order: [...globalThis.initOrder] }, '*');
};

test('existing document stays untouched until next navigation', { timeout: 12_000 }, async ({ browser }) => {
  await browser.goto('/main');
  await browser.addInitScript(first);
  await browser.addInitScript(second);
  expect(await browser.evaluate(() => globalThis.initOrder ?? [])).toEqual([]);
  expect(await browser.evaluate(() => globalThis.firstInline)).toEqual([]);
  await browser.goto('/next');
  expect(await browser.evaluate(() => ({ first: globalThis.firstInline, final: globalThis.initOrder }))).toEqual({ first: ['first', 'second'], final: ['first', 'second'] });
});

test('popup first inline sees each init once and reload starts a fresh document', { timeout: 12_000 }, async ({ browser }) => {
  await browser.addInitScript(first);
  await browser.addInitScript(second);
  await browser.goto('/main');
  const snapshots = await browser.evaluate(() => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let child;
    const snapshots = [];
    const dispose = () => { removeEventListener('message', received); removeEventListener('pagehide', dispose); };
    const received = event => {
      if (event.source !== child || event.origin !== location.origin || event.data?.kind !== 'init-document') return;
      // Normalize absent init scripts so the documented first-document
      // limitation stays JSON-safe instead of failing the whole evaluation.
      snapshots.push({ first: event.data?.snapshot?.first ?? null, final: event.data?.snapshot?.final ?? null });
      if (snapshots.length === 1) { child.location.reload(); return; }
      dispose(); child.close(); resolve(snapshots);
    };
    addEventListener('message', received);
    addEventListener('pagehide', dispose, { once: true });
    child = window.open('/popup');
    if (!child) { dispose(); reject(new Error('Synthetic popup missing')); }
  }));
  // CONTRACT: a browser shared with another CDP client lets that client release
  // a popup's start pause before native registers init scripts. The popup's
  // first document is therefore best effort (it may miss the scripts or run one
  // twice); a document created after registration is guaranteed.
  expect(snapshots[1]).toEqual({ first: ['first', 'second'], final: ['first', 'second'] });
  expect(Object.keys(snapshots[0]).toSorted()).toEqual(['final', 'first']);
});

test('blank popup has each init once before explicit first navigation', { timeout: 12_000 }, async ({ browser }) => {
  await browser.addInitScript(first);
  await browser.addInitScript(second);
  await browser.goto('/main');
  await browser.evaluate(() => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let child;
    const dispose = () => { removeEventListener('message', received); removeEventListener('pagehide', dispose); };
    const received = event => {
      if (event.source !== child || event.origin !== location.origin || event.data?.kind !== 'init-blank') return;
      dispose(); resolve(null);
    };
    addEventListener('message', received);
    addEventListener('pagehide', dispose, { once: true });
    child = window.open('about:blank');
    globalThis.blankChild = child;
    if (!child) { dispose(); reject(new Error('Synthetic popup missing')); }
  }));
  // Separate public operation: the ready signal is not itself a registration
  // ACK. Normal engine admission must finish enrollment before this read.
  const snapshots = await browser.evaluate(() => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = globalThis.blankChild;
    if (!child) { reject(new Error('Synthetic popup missing')); return; }
    const blank = [...(child.initOrder ?? [])];
    const dispose = () => { removeEventListener('message', received); removeEventListener('pagehide', dispose); };
    const received = event => {
      if (event.source !== child || event.origin !== location.origin || event.data?.kind !== 'init-document') return;
      dispose(); child.close(); delete globalThis.blankChild;
      resolve({ blank, next: event.data.snapshot });
    };
    addEventListener('message', received);
    addEventListener('pagehide', dispose, { once: true });
    child.location.href = '/popup';
  }));
  // CONTRACT: the initial blank document is best effort when the browser is
  // shared with another CDP client; the explicit first navigation is created
  // after registration and is guaranteed.
  expect(snapshots.next).toEqual({ first: ['first', 'second'], final: ['first', 'second'] });
  expect(Array.isArray(snapshots.blank)).toBe(true);
});

test('popup navigation it started itself keeps the guaranteed document boundary', { timeout: 12_000 }, async ({ browser }) => {
  await browser.addInitScript(first);
  await browser.addInitScript(second);
  await browser.goto('/main');
  const snapshots = await browser.evaluate(() => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let child;
    const snapshots = [];
    const dispose = () => { removeEventListener('message', received); removeEventListener('pagehide', dispose); };
    const received = event => {
      if (event.source !== child || event.origin !== location.origin || event.data?.kind !== 'init-document') return;
      // Normalize absent init scripts so the documented first-document
      // limitation stays JSON-safe instead of failing the whole evaluation.
      snapshots.push({ path: event.data?.path ?? null, first: event.data?.snapshot?.first ?? null, final: event.data?.snapshot?.final ?? null });
      if (snapshots.length === 1) return; // The popup navigates itself to /next; the parent only listens.
      dispose(); child.close(); resolve(snapshots);
    };
    addEventListener('message', received);
    addEventListener('pagehide', dispose, { once: true });
    child = window.open('/self-nav');
    if (!child) { dispose(); reject(new Error('Synthetic popup missing')); }
  }));
  expect(snapshots.map(entry => entry.path)).toEqual(['/self-nav', '/next']);
  // CONTRACT: the popup's first document is best effort when the browser is
  // shared with another CDP client. The document its own navigation creates is
  // started after registration, so each init runs there exactly once, before
  // the document's own script.
  expect(snapshots[1]).toEqual({ path: '/next', first: ['first', 'second'], final: ['first', 'second'] });
  expect(Object.keys(snapshots[0]).toSorted()).toEqual(['final', 'first', 'path']);
});
